== Acquisition ==
This skill is given to Rangers competing in a [[Dwayna Vs Grenth]] match, as well as in [[Wintersday]] quests.

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Barrage}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Lava Arrows}}

== Notes ==
* This skill is only available to players during [[Wintersday]] events.
* Unlike [[Snowball]], activating this skill does not generate [[adrenaline]].
{{anomaly|The descriptions omit the fact that a snowball is also thrown at the target, allowing a maximum of 5 snowballs per activation.}}
